text: This report recommends approving as needed contracts with AFIMAC Canada for specialized security services through the period of the labour disruption at Exhibition Place related to the collective agreement negotiations with IATSE Local 58. This recommendation follows the competitive process undertaken by Exhibition Place considering security companies that have previous experience providing these specialized services. Bids were sought from four (4) companies and three (3) proposals were received. Councillor Mark Grimes, Chair of the Board, approved these contracts pursuant to the authority under the Financial By-law 2-16 pending approval of the Board.
